title: Ask LLMs Directly, “What shapes your bias?”: Measuring Social Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias towards different age groups by assigning various age-based personas to LLMs and scoring their target selections on positive and negative multiple-choice questions from the BBQ dataset using Target Bias (TB), Bias Amount (BAMT), and Persona Bias (PB) metrics.
Measuring social perceptions and prejudices towards racial and ethnic identities by assigning corresponding personas to LLMs and analyzing their responses to polarized questions in the BBQ dataset.

Quantifying bias towards religious groups by prompting persona-assigned LLMs with ambiguous and disambiguated contexts from the BBQ dataset and calculating reward/penalty scores based on their answers.
Assessing bias related to socioeconomic status by assigning high- and low-SES profession personas to LLMs and evaluating their target preferences on QA tasks from the BBQ dataset.
Evaluating model preferences regarding sexual orientations by using a question-answering format with persona-assigned LLMs responding to BBQ dataset prompts and aggregating their social perceptions.
